subject: Anchor credit + sliding rev-share for CloudHaven AWS private offer — approval needed
messages:
From: Emily Harrison <emily.harrison@cloudhaven.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.inference.com>
Date: 2028-09-06T10:12:00-07:00
Subject: Private listing ask — anchor credit + sliding rev-share proposal

Hi Soojin,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the team at CloudHaven is excited to move toward an AWS private offer listing. We put together a commercial proposal we can sign quickly if Redwood can support two nonstandard items: 

- Upfront anchoring credit to offset onboarding and initial integration costs: $100,000 credit against first-year usage.
- Sliding rev-share: 40% marketplace rev-share for first 12 months (to help with co-selling), stepping down to 25% for months 13–36 as committed usage ramps.

We'd like the private offer to be listed in AWS marketplace under the CloudHaven account and to have the standard Redwoods listing terms otherwise, except for:
- Term: 36 months with 12-month minimum consumption guarantee (we'll share forecasts)
- Payment terms: Net60 (their procurement prefers Net60)
- Data retention: standard EU residency clause is not required for this customer, AWS region: us-east-1

Attached: CloudHaven-SOW-v2.pdf and a usage forecast. Please let me know what approvals you need internally and any suggested modifications.

Best,
Emily
Head of Partnerships, CloudHaven
Emily.harrison@cloudhaven.com

Attachments: CloudHaven-SOW-v2.pdf (application/pdf), CH-usage-forecast-Q4-29.xlsx (spreadsheet)

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.inference.com>
To: Cloud Deal Desk <dealdesk@redwood.inference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.inference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.inference.com>
Date: 2028-09-06T12:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Private listing ask — anchor credit + sliding rev-share proposal

Marissa / Deal Desk — forwarding CloudHaven's ask. Summary of their requested exceptions below and my suggested guardrails: 

Ask from CloudHaven:
- $100k upfront anchoring credit against year 1 usage
- Sliding rev-share: 40% months 0–12, 25% months 13–36
- 36-month term, 12-month minimum consumption guarantee
- Net60 payment terms (procurement requirement)

My read / suggested compromise:
- Anchor credit: propose $80k amortized over 12 months (credit applied monthly to invoices, clawback if they churn before 12 months)
- Rev-share: cap initial rev-share at 35% first 12 months, step to 22% months 13–36 — keeps economics within our comps and preserves marketplace margin for channel ops
- Term: OK for 36 months if we secure minimum committed spend guarantee with explicit churn clawback and pro-rata repayment of remaining credit on early termination
- Payment: prefer Net30 but can accept Net45 with a small early-pay credit to them (1.5%) — finance (Aditya) please advise on treasury impact

Questions for legal: indemnity, data residency note (they say not required), audit rights. Emily is expecting a quick yes/no this week; they want to launch listing in AWS in the next 3–4 weeks.

I've attached a 1-pager with the suggested commercial redlines for quick review: soojin-summary-commercials.pdf

Next requested action: Marissa — can you sign off on the proposed tradeoffs above or indicate upper limits for the anchor and rev-share? Vivek, if there are channel / marketplace ops considerations please flag any operational blockers. Aditya, quick treasury note on Net45 / early-pay credit would be appreciated.

Thanks — Soojin
Principal Sales Manager | Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.inference.com

Attachments: soojin-summary-commercials.pdf (application/pdf)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.inference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.inference.com>, Legal <legal@redwood.inference.com>
Date: 2028-09-07T09:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Private listing ask — anchor credit + sliding rev-share proposal

Thanks for the clear summary, Soojin. Quick takes: 

- Anchor credit: I will not approve $100k. I can approve up to $70k provided: (a) credit amortized over 12 months, (b) a clawback clause on termination before 12 months, and (c) a milestone tied to launch (listing live in marketplace within 45 days).
- Rev-share: 35% is ok as an upper bound for months 0–12, with a written commitment (SLA) that CloudHaven will hit the forecasted usage threshold in the attached workbook. After month 12, rev-share should step to 20% months 13–36.
- Term & payment: 36 months is acceptable if we get a minimum committed spend schedule; Net60 is a no from finance unless offset by a 2% early-pay credit for Net30. Aditya — can you confirm cashflow sensitivity to Net60 vs Net45?
- Legal: loop in Legal to review proposed indemnities and data clauses; do not accept open-ended indemnity or expanded audit rights without limits.

If Legal signs off on the indemnity/data language and finance confirms the Net60 sensitivity, I will approve conditional exceptions and ask Deal Desk to produce a final private offer template for AWS. We should also require DocuSign and HubSpot updated deal record before listing.

Action items: Soojin — please get confirmed usage thresholds and a signature from CloudHaven on the commit schedule; Legal — please review the SOW for indemnity language; Aditya — quick treasury / AR note.

Marissa
VP, Sales | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.inference.com>
To: Emily Harrison <emily.harrison@cloudhaven.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.inference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.inference.com>, Legal <legal@redwood.inference.com>
Date: 2028-09-08T15:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Private listing ask — anchor credit + sliding rev-share proposal (Approved conditionally)

Emily — thanks for the patience. We're able to approve CloudHaven's AWS private listing with these conditions: 

1) Commercials (finalized):
   - Anchor credit: $70,000 amortized monthly over first 12 months; full clawback if CloudHaven terminates before 12 months (pro-rata repayment).
   - Rev-share: 35% months 0–12, stepping to 20% months 13–36.
   - Term: 36 months with a signed minimum committed spend schedule (we need this in DocuSign).
   - Payment: Net45 standard; if CloudHaven requires Net60, a 2% early-pay credit will be added to the offer to offset cash impact.

2) Legal & Ops:
   - Legal will review SOW redlines focusing on indemnity caps and audit scope — no expanded open-ended indemnities permitted.
   - Marketplace Ops (Vivek) will coordinate the AWS private listing; requires HubSpot deal update and signed DocuSign bundle before live listing.

3) Timing:
   - We need the signed commit schedule + SOW updates by 9/20/2028 to meet the 45-day launch window.

Next steps for you, Emily: please confirm acceptance of the $70k anchor and revised rev-share profile, and route the signed commit schedule via DocuSign to marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com. I will ask Deal Desk to issue the private offer once Legal confirms SOW language.

DocuSign link for reference: https://www.docusign.com/en/documents/rdw-cloudhaven-privoffer
HubSpot record: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/company/CH-000919

Thanks — looking forward to getting this live.

Sooj/Marissa/Vivek/Aditya
